items.title: What’s With All These Outages?
items.summary: This week on “Uncanny Valley,” we discuss the outages that have swept digital life over the past week, where new money from Anthropic’s IPO is going, and the AI chip world post-Jensen Huang.
items.author: Brian Barrett, Leah Feiger, Sophie Kleeman

items.title: The Jensen Huang Blast Radius Has Hit His Favorite Restaurants
items.summary: In Taiwan, some food vendors are distancing themselves from Nvidia’s former CEO. Others stand by him. “It’s not as if he killed someone or set something on fire,” says one shop owner.
items.author: Amy Chang Chien

items.title: Google Built a Giant ‘Mirror Dimension’ Internet to Test Its Chrome AI Agents
items.summary: The company’s alternate-universe internet serves as a massive sandbox that allows the Chrome team to properly train AI browsing agents—without the risk of them going rogue.
items.author: Lily Hay Newman

items.title: Anthropic’s Record-Breaking IPO Highlights the AI Giant’s Worst Enemy—Itself
items.summary: Investors betting a barnstorming $107 billion will weigh whether the company’s AI safety strategy and growing public anger toward data centers could impact its growth.
items.author: Paresh Dave
